component.name: Cortex
component.summary: A personal AI assistant that learns how you work

description.p: Cortex is a desktop AI assistant that works with the models you choose, in the cloud or on your own computer, and grows with you: it remembers what you tell it about yourself, learns skills from the work its agents do, and checks itself against the cases you write.

ul.li: Chat with any provider, or with built-in models that run on this computer
Agents with their own instructions, tools and schedules
Knowledge and facts you can see, edit and delete
Connectors, libraries and a sandbox for code
